items.title: Crocodile sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake
items.snippet_en: On December 1, 2024, Star of Mysore reported that morning walkers spotted a huge crocodile near the fishermen's shed in Kukkarahalli Lake, Mysore. The article confirms the presence of crocodiles in the lake and notes that this was not the first sighting.

Star of Mysore reported a crocodile sighting at Kukkarahalli Lake on January 28, 2026. The article mentioned that while the lake is a known crocodile habitat, sightings are rare, and a specific crocodile had been spotted four times.
Andolana reported on March 3, 2024, that a crocodile was seen in Kukkarahalli Lake on a Sunday evening by people walking there.

Star of Mysore reported on September 8, 2023, that morning walkers were concerned after spotting a crocodile in Kukkarahalli Lake the previous morning. Crocodiles had been spotted before and rescued by the Forest Department.

items.title: Giant crocodile appears near Mysore lake
items.snippet_en: The Hindu reported on March 26, 2010, that a giant crocodile was spotted on the Kukkarahalli Lake bund, reaffirming the presence of crocodiles in the lake after several years.
A Facebook post mentions reports of a crocodile being spotted at Kukkarahalli Lake during an evening walk, and that crocodiles in community lakes can be aggressive.

outputs.notes_en: The claim states that two crocodiles were seen in Kukkarahalli Lake yesterday evening. While multiple sources confirm crocodile sightings in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysore, none of them specifically mention two crocodiles being seen yesterday evening (October 8, 2026). The sources provide context that crocodile sightings are not uncommon in this lake, but do not directly support or contradict the specific claim about the number of crocodiles or the exact date.
